Name: Logo's Hodgepodge
Author: 0Logophile0
Description:
[font=Georgia][size=4]This mod was born from the want of more options for chest retextures that blended in with my biblio-jungle-boho-maximalist decorating style.

[u]Alternative Textures Version[/u]
[list]
[*]57 variations of chest retextures (mostly stacks of books, but there are a few random items added in)
[*]30 variations of house plant retextures
[*]75 variations of decorative retextures (including the stacks of books, in case you don't want them to be functional chests)
[/list]
✨✨ [b]NEW! - [/b][u]Content Patcher version, coded by [/u][url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Abagaianye?gameId=1303]Abagaianye[/url][u]﻿![/u] (Thank you so so much for making this version! 🌟🪻)
[list]
[*]89 [i]new[/i] furniture pieces added to the base furniture catalogue purchased from Robin
[/list]

﻿[/size][/font][img]https://files.catbox.moe/7a7fhz.png[/img]﻿

[size=4][u]Alternative Textures Version[/u][/size]
[list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Download this mod and make sure you have Alternative Textures installed.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Place this mod into your /Mods folder.[/size][/font]
[/list][font=Georgia][size=4]
[/size][/font][size=4][u]Content Patcher Version[/u]
[list]
[*][font=Georgia]Download and place into your /Mods folder![/font]
[/list][/size]

[img]https://files.catbox.moe/b1fb7l.png[/img]﻿

[u][size=4]Alternative Textures Version[/size][/u]
[list=1]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Get thee a Paint Bucket from Robin.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Chests, Stone Chests, Big Chests, Big Stone Chests, and Junimo Chests can all be retextured.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Standard house plants can all be retextured.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]For the decorative retextures, just select the Oak End Table.[/size][/font]
[/list]
[font=Georgia][size=4]Content Patcher Version[/size][/font]
[list=1]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]All items are added to the vanilla Furniture Catalogue that is purchased from Robin.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]72 New decor items[/size][/font]
[*]17 New Book Stack "end tables" (they rotate!)

[/list][font=Georgia][size=4]

[/size][/font]
[img]https://files.catbox.moe/x4nzqr.png[/img]﻿

[font=Georgia][size=4]All sprites were frankensprited from CA's original game assets.

A very very special thank you to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Abagaianye?gameId=1303]Abagaianye[/url]﻿, who made the Content Patcher version for their own personal use and who was so generous and thoughtful to offer to share it! 🌟🌟💜 

Special thank you to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Doragoun/about-me?gameId=1303]Doragoun[/url]﻿ - your encouragement and advice early on really helped me get through my fear of trying something new.

Thank you to my friends in the SDV modding community, for the unfailing support. ✨🤍
